organism.morph_detail: Silurian trilobite meraspid larva, 12 thoracic segments, early morph of the Aulacopleura chronoseries
organism.spelling_note: Barrande's spelling Aulacopleura konincki is the form used in Fusco et al. 2004 and Hughes & Chapman 1995. This slot follows the campaign spelling koninckii.

phenomenon_scale.label: 3.1 µm
phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Aulacopleura koninckii meraspis (3.1 µm, detail scale)
phenomenon_scale.interpretation: Classical critical wavelength λ_c = 2π/k_c of a near-onset Schnakenberg system in the meraspid integument, selecting cuticular pigment-lira spacing. Not thoracic segment length and not the 183 µm primordium stripe of the sibling meraspis Turing slot.

successor.name: Aulacopleura koninckii_holaspis18
successor.what_changes_at_this_scale: k_c is conserved if epithelial kinetics and diffusivities are stage-invariant. Hemianamorphosis changes the trunk from 12 to 18 thoracic segments (surplus 6). The thorax therefore hosts 1.5 times as many segment-bounded copies of the same 3.125 µm lira wavelength. The successor is not a retuning of the subcellular wavenumber.

equations.pde: ∂u/∂t = D_u ∇²u + γ (a − u + u² v);  ∂v/∂t = D_v ∇²v + γ (b − u² v)
equations.steady_state: u0 = a + b;  v0 = b / (a + b)²
equations.jacobian: f_u = −1 + 2 u0 v0;  f_v = u0²;  g_u = −2 u0 v0;  g_v = −u0²; physical entries multiply by γ
equations.dispersion: σ² − Tr(k) σ + Δ(k) = 0; Tr(k) = γ(f_u + g_v) − k² (D_u + D_v); Δ(k) = D_u D_v k⁴ − (D_v γ f_u + D_u γ g_v) k² + det(γ J)
equations.k_c: k_c² = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v) with f, g the physical Jacobian; λ_c = 2π / k_c
equations.boundary_conditions: Periodic boundaries on a one-dimensional anteroposterior transect through a pleural epithelial patch (mediolaterally uniform lirae). The 2D patch uses the same periodic conditions on both axes.

parameters.note: Reconstructed so the classical k_c equals 2π / 3.125 µm and the diffusion ratio sits 2% above the Schnakenberg onset. Not taken from a published trilobite RD table. Distinct from the 183 µm primordium-slot parameters.

empirical_claims: Meraspid growth of Aulacopleura konincki adds thoracic segments; holaspid trunk segment number is variable (Fusco, Hughes, Webster & Minelli 2004, Am. Nat. 163:167–183).
Growth and variation of this Wenlock proetide are quantified by Hughes & Chapman 1995 (Lethaia 28:333–353).

Trilobite trunk segmentation is hemianamorphic: segments are released from the pygidium during the meraspid period and the holaspid phase begins when segment addition stops (Hughes, Minelli & Fusco 2006; Hughes 2007).
A Turing system selects an intrinsic chemical wavelength from reaction kinetics and diffusivities (Turing 1952). The critical wavenumber used here is the marginal-stability mode k_c.
Schnakenberg kinetics are a two-species activator–substrate system with a stable homogeneous steady state that can be diffusion-driven unstable (Schnakenberg 1979).

On a growing domain the number of wavelengths that fit changes with domain length even when k_c is fixed (Murray 1981 scale argument, applied here to segment number rather than to a continuous dilation of λ).

specimen.creator: Dwergenpaartje
specimen.note: Vendored file is the Commons original (2167×2552). The campaign gallery JPEG is a smaller recompression of the same dorsal photograph, not a different individual.

reported_in_source: Aulacopleura konincki from the Wenlock of Bohemia adds thoracic segments during the meraspid period; holaspid segment number varies (Fusco et al. 2004; Hughes & Chapman 1995).
Turing 1952 and Schnakenberg 1979 supply the dispersion relation and the two-species kinetics. They do not mention this trilobite.
reconstructed_in_script: a, b, D_u, D_v/D_u and γ are chosen so λ_c = 3.125 µm exactly and the ratio D_v/D_u is 2% above the analytical onset for these kinetics.
The M12 → holaspis18 comparison at this scale is the segment surplus 6 under a conserved k_c, not a measured shift of λ.
transfer_boundary: Applying a vertebrate-coat scale argument (Murray 1981) to trilobite cuticular lirae is an analogy of wavelength selection, not a claim that trilobite pigment chemistry is Schnakenberg kinetics.
does_not_claim: That 3.125 µm was measured on the vendored photograph (the photo cannot resolve that spacing).
That the dorsal photograph is a verified degree-12 meraspis; furrow counts are measured and compared with the assigned count of 12.
That a Turing mechanism has been demonstrated in the Silurian fossil.
